title: The CTS Master Package v1 is the first external proof layer.
summary: This page proves the package exists and shows safe structure only. Raw operational templates, restricted field internals, local paths, and live connector behavior stay outside public and demo routes.

proof_cards.label: Package exists
proof_cards.text: The CTS Master Package v1 ZIP was parsed, verified by SHA256, and its safe structure was extracted into public proof metadata.

proof_cards.label: Raw ZIP excluded
proof_cards.text: The source ZIP was not committed to the repository. Only sanitized summary, component list, manifest, and authority map are public.

proof_cards.label: Private internals protected
proof_cards.text: Operational templates, restricted field data, local file paths, and connector behavior are not included in any public or demo route.
